scope: Additive Dark Orb L1-18 Minion Prince Equipment audit of active projectile damage, slow and unresolved collision and effect timing.
game_version: November 2024 Minion Prince release; November 2025 TH18 Equipment HP rebalance; secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: THE TOWN HALL 17 UPDATE IS HERE!
facts: Minion Prince is a permanent flying Home Village Hero specializing in damage and weakening defenses.
sources.limitations: The article does not name Dark Orb or provide its projectile mechanics.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
facts: All Minion Prince Equipment gained 500 HP as part of the TH18 defensive rebalance.
sources.limitations: No projectile damage, slow, range or event order is stated.

sources.title: Town Hall 17 is here!
facts: Dark Orb is default Minion Prince Equipment; activation launches an orb that damages and slows everything it touches.
sources.limitations: The release summary does not define target classes, travel speed, collision radius, splash, stacking or tick ordering.

sources.title: Dark Orb — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The dated L1-18 Minion Prince DPS 10-73, HP 588-1140 and ore table matches the pinned raw record except at L8: dated HP bonus 690 versus pinned raw 600.
The page describes an orb that damages and slows touched entities.
sources.limitations: The table omits projectile damage, slow percentages/durations, geometry and timing.

sources.title: Pinned Dark Orb Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The pinned record contains L1-18 projectile damage 45-200, slow 20-50 percent for 8-18 seconds, and per-level Minion Prince HP/DPS bonuses.
sources.limitations: Current effect continuity and projectile collision/timing are not verified by a dated primary source.

sources.title: Dark Orb (Tropas) — Clash of Clans
facts: The page repeats the pinned damage, slow and duration bands, including L18 200 damage, 50 percent and 18 seconds.
sources.limitations: Game build and derivation are missing, and at least one HP row conflicts with the dated table; it is not accepted as current effect validation.

observations.note: Effect bands are pinned historical data only. The dated table corroborates Hero DPS and HP except for a sourced L8 correction: 690 rather than the pinned raw 600.

derivations.result: Retain all historical per-level fields and expose dated L8 HP correction
derivations.method: Recheck immutable raw payload and the dated 2026 client-file table; preserve raw L8 600 and expose sourced 690 separately.

derivations.result: Classify as active damage-and-slow orb without Core actor
derivations.method: Use the dated launch report and pinned abilityType; retain historical effect bands without inferring projectile travel or slow application.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply slow to every building and troop along a straight line
rejected_inferences.reason: The report says everything touched but does not define collision geometry, target classes or travel path.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use a fixed projectile speed or shared Giant Arrow path
rejected_inferences.reason: No consulted source gives speed, width, launch angle or termination.

rejected_inferences.rule: Convert 50 percent slow to halved attack cooldown and movement steps
rejected_inferences.reason: The source does not specify which clocks or movement scalar are affected or how existing cooldown is rescheduled.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply damage and slow on launch tick
rejected_inferences.reason: Projectile flight, impact order and target death handling are unspecified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the unversioned third-party table as proof of current effect values
rejected_inferences.reason: Its build is missing and one unrelated HP value conflicts with the dated 2026 source.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat pinned raw L8 HP bonus 600 as current
rejected_inferences.reason: The dated 2026 client-file table explicitly reports 690 at L8 while agreeing on the other 17 HP rows.

items: current projectile damage, slow percent and duration continuity
activation command, launch direction, trajectory, speed, width and collision
ground/air, building, Hero, Pet and spawned-unit target eligibility
damage, mitigation, slow application, expiry and integer rounding order
interaction with Frozen Arrow, other slows, Rage, Haste, traps and defensive cooldowns
Minion Prince HP/DPS stacking and death timing
Viewer projectile art, controls, overlays, snapshot, replay and RL activation

conclusion: Dark Orb L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. The dated table confirms Hero DPS and all but one raw HP row; its L8 690 HP correction is additive. Pinned projectile and slow bands lack a complete current collision and tick contract.

dated_2026_hero_hp_bonus_by_level.note: The pinned source_fields retains historical raw L8 600; this current-build table explicitly reports 690.
